proposedOverrides.summary: This imported “Germany” record covers 1878-1945, spanning the German Empire, Weimar Republic and Nazi dictatorship rather than one unchanging regime. Industrial growth and public health reforms changed homes; war, 1923 inflation and the Holocaust brought terrible harm. Nazi Germany launched European war and murdered six million Jews and millions of others. The regime collapsed in 1945 and occupation followed, while German people continued. Separate cards cover the Empire and postwar German states.

proposedOverrides.summary: Germany reunited on 3 October 1990 when the German Democratic Republic joined the Federal Republic; the imported map begins only in 1994. The 1949 Basic Law and its human-dignity principle continued. Families had to navigate changed jobs, schools, health systems and homes, while migration gave Germany many languages and communities. A 2022 census still tracks home toilets and baths separately. Germany continues as a federal republic, and the earlier East and West histories remain distinct.
